question: India's first-ever SAI Centre of Excellence for mountain terrain biking and bicycle motocross is to be set up in ________.
solution:
The correct answer is __**Shimla.**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The** Sports Authority of India (SAI)** has announced the establishment of India's** first-ever Centre of Excellence** for **mountain terrain biking **and **bicycle motocross** in **Shimla, Himachal Pradesh.**
 
• The centre will provide world-class facilities for **training, research, and development** in these sports disciplines.
 
• The initiative aims to promote these sports in India and nurture **young talent **to represent the country at the international level.
 
• The centre will also provide employment opportunities for** local youth and boost tourism** in the region.
